Name: NoCollision
Author: tbonehunter
Description: I was tired of my dog constantly blocking access to my doorway or bed, and frustrated with the cows trapping me inside the gate, not to mention all too often getting trapped by junimos carrying bundles out of rooms in the community center. This mod allows you to pass through pets, horses, junimos, livestock, villagerNPCs and monsters without hindrance. Included toggle for pass through anything (no clip mode). Each category of NPC can be toggled on/off via config.json or in-game GMCM menu. Works in multi-player LAN and local coop. Toggling Monsters to no-collision means that they can't hurt you, so it's kind of a cheat but when you want a relaxing mining excursion, it's helpful.

Downloads.Description: revised i18n file and modentry.cs to enable translation files to be effective in GMCM
